answer: In arXiv 2501.10391, the existing ontologies identified as most relevant for the AI Act are AIRO (AI Risk Ontology) and VAIR (Vocabulary of AI Risks). Their integration into the Data Privacy Vocabulary (DPV) is described as follows: AIRO and VAIR are being integrated for the upcoming DPV version 2.1, and the authors aim to support this integration by identifying concepts not present in these existing ontologies. The DPV is noted as the only resource that has modeled GDPR and has been expanded to also model the AI Act using the same core concepts.
